_comment: Since Phase 3 (plans/score-template-exam-generation, Plan A), this file only covers what the pinned ScoreTemplate can't: PERSONAL_INTRODUCTION (UNSCORED, not one of the 22 template rows) and the 5 audio-prompt Speaking types' preListenSeconds (a client-facing sub-stage split length, not a scoring concern — no ScoreTemplateItem column for it). Every other task type's prepSeconds/responseSeconds/scoringMethod now comes from the ACTIVE ScoreTemplate pinned onto the snapshot at publish time (see SnapshotPinService, ScoreTemplateItem). The 5 audio-prompt types' preRecordSeconds also moved to the template (its 'prep' column, by the seed convention documented in V14__score_template.sql) — removed from here, not just left unused, so this file can't silently drift from the template's value. Do NOT add any task type back here that the template already covers; SnapshotPinService.toPinnedItem() decides source (template vs. this file) by whether TaskTimingConfig.timingForIfConfigured() finds an entry at all, not by task type name.
